sections.heading: 1. What happens
lines: ① A chat about goals, injuries and health history.
③ Try a few exercises on the mat and reformer.

sections.heading: 2. Let us know if…
lines: You've had recent surgery or injury, and
stop if you feel pain or dizziness.

caption:
Nervous about your first clinical Pilates session? Momo is very bendy, but the reformer was brand new to her.

It starts with a conversation about your goals, injuries and health history. Then we look at how you move with simple tests like squats, balance and rotation. There's no pass or fail; we're just working out where to start.

Next, you'll try a few exercises on the mat and reformer to get a feel for the springs and breathing cues. You'll leave with a program, whether one-on-one or small classes suit you, and a couple of things to practise at home.

Bring comfortable clothes, grip socks and any recent scans. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio welcomes complete beginners. Book online via the link in bio 🐱

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
